description: Syllable counts per line, caller dictionary first, labelled English heuristic second — Counts syllables per word and per line for English text, using your dictionary entries first and otherwise a rule-based estimator (vowel groups, silent e, -ed/-es, consonant+le). Optionally checks each line against a target pattern such as 5-7-5. Where the rules cannot decide (vowel pairs like ia/io/eo, acronyms, numerals, non-Latin scripts) the word is a range or abstains, and a line whose count

dictionary.description: Caller counts; they override the rules.

items.description: Target syllables for the line at the same position.
